title: MapMyFitness Activity Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Strava API activities (`strava:activity`), Garmin Connect (`garmin:activity`), Fitbit Web API (`fitbit:activity`), Peloton workout history (`peloton:workout`), Zwift/TrainingPeaks exports.
app: Strava / Garmin Connect / Fitbit / Peloton / Zwift APIs and webhooks via Splunk HEC scripted inputs; GPX/FIT/CSV activity exports ingested as files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mapmyfitness:activity
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(workout_type) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many MapMyFitness activity events land each day and how many distinct workout type values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest MapMyFitness activity records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct workout type values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It will log how much MapMyFitness activity activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
